title: Is a 200 € Raise Really 200 €? 💶 #shorts
description:
Guess how much of a 200 € raise lands in your account. Comment a number!

2,500 € → 2,700 € gross a month in Germany (2026, tax class I, no kids, no church tax, avg. health add-on 2.9 %, age 23+): pension −18.60 €, health/care/unemployment −24.30 €, income tax −41.50 € → about +116 € net. And no, a raise never pushes your whole salary into a higher bracket.

Sources: BMF Programmablaufplan 2026 (via ihk-muenchen.de), TK contribution rates 2026 (tk.de), cross-check: brutto-netto-rechner.digital

Not financial advice.
